body:
Used this script to automatically do it:

``` sh
#! /usr/bin/bash

for wrapper in String Number Boolean; do
  prim=`echo $wrapper | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'`
  for file in `echo README.md widgets/*/*.js`; do
    for i in `seq 3`; do
      sed -i -r "s/(@param.*)(${wrapper})/\1${prim}/g" $file
    done
  done
done
```

I think it should have gotten all of them. Maybe you can think of some other places than on the `@param` lines where we should replace them?

comments.body: ~~I think we can just replace Function and Object too~~
